|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Defiance Banner''' is a [[banner]] [[aura]] [[skill]]. After gaining [[Valour]] from melee combat, it can be activated, consuming all Valour and placing a banner that [[buff]]s the user and [[allies]] within an area with increased [[movement speed]], additional chance to [[suppress]] spell damage, and a flat subtraction to [[damage taken]] from suppressed spell hits. The effect of the aura is multiplied based on the amount of Valour consumed. ==Skill functions and interactions== When the banner is placed with 50 Valour, the buff provides {{c|mod|48% increased Movement Speed to You and Allies}}, {{c|mod|+48% chance to Suppress Spell Damage to You and Allies}}, and {{c|mod|-72 Damage taken of each Damage Type from Suppressed Hits to You and Allies}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Area per
Valour |c1_header = x% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_value = %s%% |c2_abbr = Aura Effect
per Valour |c2_header = x% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_value = %s%% |c3_abbr = Flat damage
reduction |c3_header = Banner grants -x Damage taken of each Damage Type from Suppressed Hits to You and Allies |c3_pattern_extract = Banner grants -(.+) Damage taken of each Damage Type from Suppressed Hits to You and Allies |c3_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== Defiance Banner cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Defiance Banner%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Defiance Banner%" OR items.description LIKE "%your banner%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to Defiance Banner: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%Defiance%Banner%" OR items.name LIKE "%Perfidy%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Is no longer a Reservation skill, and has none of its previous stats. You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. While you have no placed banner, you can gain Valour. Now has a base duration of 10 seconds, and a base radius of 2.4 metres. Provides 5% more Area of Effect and 5% more Aura Effect per Valour Consumed at gem level 1, both scaling up to 10% at gem level 20. Banner grants 8% increased Movement Speed, +8% chance to Suppress Spell Damage to You and Allies. It also grants -5 Damage taken from Suppressed Hits to You and Allies at gem level 1, scaling up to -12 at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * Now grants {{c|mod|You and nearby Allies have '''(15-24)%''' increased Armour and Evasion Rating}} (previously 30–49%). * Now grants {{c|mod|Nearby Enemies have '''(30-40)%''' reduced Critical Strike Chance}} (previously 20–29%). * Anomalous quality now grants {{c|mod|You and nearby Allies have 0.25% increased Armour and Evasion Rating}} (previously 0.5%). }} {{Version history table row|3.15.0| * Defiance Banner has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
